messages.author: 17f8070912132195
messages.subject: Get fitted values
parts:
Hi all,

I want to get a part of the model fitted values. My model formular is:

log(y) ~ b0 + f(x1, rw1) + f(x2,rw2) + f(s, spde)

Using res$summary.fitted.values[inla.stack.index(stk,"est")$data, "mean"] can give me the fitted values
BUT I want to exclude the effect of x1, namely, get the fitted values of b0 + f(x2,rw2) + f(s, spde).

Is there any convenient way to get these values?

Thanks,
Ruby

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Get fitted values
parts:
I know two options. 1) add extra rows to the dataset were both y and x1 are NA. 2) define linear combinations. See http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-I-have-some-linear-combinations-of-the-nodes-in-the-latent-field-that-I-want-to-compute-the-posterior-marginal-of-is-that-possible-
